description: Land Acquisition - Udaliamulla, Sri Jayawardanapura, Kotte D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette notice is about land acquisition for the expansion of Udahamulla Railway Station Road. It contains detailed descriptions of 16 specific land parcels being acquired, including their locations, extents, and claimants. This content falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act.
